stepTitle: Open the Navigator
title: Navigator - Purchasing, Vision Operations (USA)

fusion.title: Navigator
fusion.path: Navigator (hamburger menu) > Procurement > Purchase Requisitions
fusion.note: In Fusion there are no 'responsibilities'. You open a Work Area from the Navigator, and what you see depends on your job role.

stepTitle: Create requisition - Find Requisitions
title: Find Requisitions
nav: Requisition > Requisition Summary, then press New

fusion.title: Manage Requisitions
fusion.path: Navigator > Procurement > Purchase Requisitions > Tasks > Manage Requisitions
fusion.note: Fusion has a search page with 'Create Requisition' under Tasks. EBS needs Find, then New.

stepTitle: Create requisition - enter the details and save
title: Requisition Summary to Requisitions - [New]

fusion.title: Create Requisition
fusion.path: Navigator > Procurement > Purchase Requisitions > Tasks > Create Requisition
fusion.note: In Fusion you fill a cart and press Submit, not 'Approve'. Approval starts when you submit.

stepTitle: Approve requisition - send for approval
title: Approve Document - {{req}}
els: Use Document GL Date to Unreserve

fusion.title: Submit Requisition
fusion.path: Create Requisition > Submit
fusion.note: Fusion shows the approval list on the Submit page. The approver gets a notification on the bell icon.

stepTitle: Approve requisition - Workflow Administrator notification search
title: Administrator Workflow
nav: Administration > Notification Search (Type Internal Name = REQAPPRV)
els: Home    Developer Studio    Business Events    Status Monitor    Notifications
Workflow Configuration   |   Vacation Rules   |   Notification Search   |   Signature Evidence Store
Enter filter criteria such as From, Workflow Type, Type Internal Name, Subject.

Select From                                                                                                                                                  Type                                   Subject                                 Sent                                Due                          End Date
Home  Developer Studio  Business Events  Status Monitor  Notifications  Administration  Home  Logout  Preferences  Help  Diagnostics

fusion.title: Approval notification (bell icon)
fusion.path: Home > Notifications (bell) > Requisition approval
fusion.note: No separate Workflow Administrator window. The approver opens the bell icon and presses Approve.

stepTitle: Approve requisition - requisition shows Approved
title: Administrator Workflow - notification
els: Home    Developer Studio    Business Events    Status Monitor    Notifications
Workflow Configuration   |   Vacation Rules   |   Notification Search   |   Signature Evidence Store
This notification does not require a response.

Line        Description                                                                              Supplier            Cost Center                  Unit                         Quantity                         Price (USD)                         Amount (USD)

Num            Name                                                    Action                                   Action Date                                                                                                                      Note

fusion.title: Notification: Requisition approved
fusion.path: Home > Notifications (bell) > Closed
fusion.note: In Fusion the requester sees the status on Manage Requisitions: Approved.

stepTitle: Create PO - message: no requisitions meet the search criteria
title: Note
nav: AutoCreate > Find (the requisition has a buyer)
els: APP-PO-14096: No requisitions meet your search criteria
There are no requisitions or requisition lines
Re-enter your search criteria with fewer or

fusion.title: Process Requisitions
fusion.path: Navigator > Procurement > Purchase Orders > Tasks > Process Requisitions
fusion.note: Fusion shows 'No results found'. The buyer is set on the requisition line, or the buyer role is assigned in the cart.

stepTitle: Create PO - AutoCreate: find the requisition
title: Find Requisition Lines

fusion.title: Process Requisitions
fusion.path: Navigator > Procurement > Purchase Orders > Tasks > Process Requisitions
fusion.note: Fusion: Procurement > Purchase Orders > Process Requisitions replaces AutoCreate.

stepTitle: Create PO - Manage Buyer Workload: find the requisition
title: Find Requisition Lines

fusion.title: Manage Requisitions (assign buyer)
fusion.path: Navigator > Procurement > Purchase Orders > Tasks > Manage Requisitions
fusion.note: In Fusion the buyer is picked from the requisition line or the Process Requisitions page.

stepTitle: Create PO - assign a buyer to the requisition line
title: Assign Requisition Lines

fusion.title: Edit Requisition Line
fusion.path: Purchase Requisitions > Manage Requisitions > Edit
fusion.note: A buyer can be set on the requisition line before the PO is created.

stepTitle: Create PO - confirmation message
title: Forms

fusion.title: Confirmation
fusion.path: Manage Requisitions > Save and Close
fusion.note: Fusion shows a short green banner at the top of the page.

stepTitle: Create PO - AutoCreate Documents (Action Create, Standard PO)
title: AutoCreate Documents

fusion.title: Process Requisitions
fusion.path: Process Requisitions > select the line > Add to Document Builder > Create Order
fusion.note: Fusion's Document Builder replaces the Manual and Automatic buttons.

stepTitle: Create PO - New Document dialog
title: New Document

fusion.title: Create Order
fusion.path: Process Requisitions > Create Order
fusion.note: Fusion asks for supplier and site here, so the PO is created with them.

stepTitle: Approve PO - the purchase order (supplier, ship-to, lines)
title: AutoCreate to Purchase Orders - {{po}}

fusion.title: Edit Order {{po}}
fusion.path: Navigator > Procurement > Purchase Orders > Tasks > Manage Orders > Edit
fusion.note: In Fusion the status stays Incomplete until you press Submit.

stepTitle: Approve PO - Shipments (receiving organisation V1)
title: Shipments - {{po}}

fusion.title: Edit Schedule (shipment)
fusion.path: Edit Order > Lines > Schedules
fusion.note: The receiving organisation (V1 here) is the ship-to organization on the schedule.

stepTitle: Approve PO - Approve Document, OK
title: Approve Document - {{po}}
els: Use Document GL Date to Unreserve

fusion.title: Submit Order
fusion.path: Edit Order > Submit
fusion.note: Fusion: Submit sends the PO for approval; after approval it can be communicated to the supplier.

stepTitle: Receive goods - choose the receiving organisation
title: Organizations

fusion.title: Receive Expected Shipments
fusion.path: Navigator > Procurement > Receiving > Receive Expected Shipments
fusion.note: Fusion starts on the Receive Expected Shipments page for your inventory organization.

stepTitle: Receive goods - Find Expected Receipts (PO number)
title: Find Expected Receipts (V1)

fusion.title: Receive Expected Shipments
fusion.path: Navigator > Procurement > Receiving > Receive Expected Shipments
fusion.note: Search by PO; the lines come up with ordered and remaining quantity.

stepTitle: Receive goods - Receipt Header
title: Receipt Header (V1)

fusion.title: Create Receipt
fusion.path: Receive Expected Shipments > select the line > Receive
fusion.note: The receipt number is assigned when you submit.

stepTitle: Receive goods - Receipts, set the quantity and save
title: Receipts (V1)

fusion.title: Create Receipt
fusion.path: Receive Expected Shipments > Receive
fusion.note: ICAI path: Procurement > My Receipt (the lab's Receipts module).

stepTitle: Inspect goods - Find Receiving Transactions
title: Find Receiving Transactions (V1)

fusion.title: Manage Receipts
fusion.path: Navigator > Procurement > Receiving > Manage Receipts
fusion.note: Fusion: Manage Receipts finds receipts and lets you inspect them.

stepTitle: Inspect goods - Receiving Transactions, press Inspect
title: Receiving Transactions (V1)

fusion.title: Manage Receipts - Inspect
fusion.path: Navigator > Procurement > Receiving > Manage Receipts > Receipt > Inspect
fusion.note: Inspection matters only for 4-way matching. Fusion supports it, the lab uses 3-way.

stepTitle: Create Payables invoice - Invoice Workbench (header)
title: Invoice Workbench (Payables, Vision Operations (USA))

fusion.title: Create Invoice
fusion.path: Navigator > Payables > Invoices > Tasks > Create Invoice
fusion.note: In Fusion, matching lines to the PO or receipt is in the Lines section. Validate is on the Actions menu.

stepTitle: Create Payables invoice - Find Receipts for Matching
title: Find Receipts for Matching (Payables, Vision Operations (USA)) - Vision Operations

fusion.title: Create Invoice - Lines
fusion.path: Create Invoice > Lines > Purchase order / Receipt
fusion.note: Fusion: add an invoice line and match it to the PO or receipt.

stepTitle: Create Payables invoice - Match to Receipts (tick Match)
title: Match to Receipts (Payables, Vision Operations (USA)) - Vision Operations

fusion.title: Create Invoice - Select Receipt Lines
fusion.path: Create Invoice > Lines > Receipt
fusion.note: Matching to the receipt means you pay only for what was received.

stepTitle: Create Payables invoice - Actions > Validate
title: Invoice Workbench (Payables, Vision Operations (USA))

fusion.title: Invoice actions
fusion.path: Payables > Invoices > Manage Invoices > Actions
fusion.note: In Fusion: Actions > Validate. Validation checks the match to the PO and receipt.

stepTitle: Pay the invoice - Payments workbench
title: Payments (Payables, Vision Operations (USA))

fusion.title: Create Payment
fusion.path: Navigator > Payables > Payments > Tasks > Create Payment
fusion.note: Fusion pays through a Payment Process Request or Create Payment. Both use payment process profiles.

stepTitle: Pay the invoice - Select Invoices to pay
title: Select Invoices (Payables, Vision Operations (USA)) - Vision Operations, 1007, Star Gate Ltd

fusion.title: Payment Process Request - Select Invoices
fusion.path: Payables > Payments > Submit Payment Process Request
fusion.note: Early-payment discount (2/10 NET 30) is taken when you pay in time.

stepTitle: Close the PO - Find Purchase Orders
title: Find Purchase Orders

fusion.title: Manage Orders
fusion.path: Navigator > Procurement > Purchase Orders > Tasks > Manage Orders
fusion.note: Fusion: Manage Orders. Closing is under Actions > Manage Document Actions.

stepTitle: Close the PO - Purchase Order Headers
title: Purchase Order Headers

fusion.title: Manage Orders - results
fusion.path: Manage Orders > Search
fusion.note: Select the order, then Actions > Manage Document Actions > Close.

stepTitle: Close the PO - Control Document, Finally Close
title: Control Document - {{po}}

fusion.title: Manage Document Actions
fusion.path: Manage Orders > Actions > Manage Document Actions
fusion.note: Fusion offers Close, Close for Invoicing and Close for Receiving.

stepTitle: Transfer to GL - Requests (Journal Import)
title: Requests
nav: View > Requests (check the GL batch name)

fusion.title: Scheduled Processes
fusion.path: Navigator > Tools > Scheduled Processes
fields: Transfer Journal Entries to General Ledger
fusion.note: Fusion: Tools > Scheduled Processes shows Create Accounting and Import Journals.

stepTitle: Transfer to GL - Journal Import Execution Report
title: Journal Import Execution Report
nav: Requests > select Journal Import > View Output
els: Total   Total    Total Total Unbalanced Total Unbalanced Total Flex Total Non-Flex
Journal Entry Source Name        Group Id Status    Lines Batches Headers      Batches          Headers      Errors     Errors
Warning Batch Name                                    Period Name  Lines Headers Accounted Debits Accounted Credits
Error Code  Journal Entry Name   Batch Name   Total Lines  Period Name   Total Debits   Total Credits
Error Code   Source   Accounting Date  Currency  Entered Debit  Entered Credit Accounting Flexfield/CCID

fusion.title: Import Journals - output
fusion.path: Tools > Scheduled Processes > Import Journals > View Output
fusion.note: The batch name here is how you find the journal in General Ledger.

stepTitle: Transfer to GL - Actions > Create Accounting, Final Post
title: Invoice Workbench (Payables, Vision Operations (USA))
nav: Invoices > query > Actions > Create Accounting > Final Post

fusion.title: Create Accounting
fusion.path: Navigator > Tools > Scheduled Processes > Create Accounting
fusion.note: Fusion runs Create Accounting as a scheduled process, then Transfer Journal Entries to GL and Import Journals.

stepTitle: Inspect goods - Inspect window (Quality Code Excellent)
title: Inspect (V1)
els: Built from the manual's text only: the manual has no screenshot of this window.

fusion.title: Inspect Receipt
fusion.path: Manage Receipts > Inspect
fusion.note: The manual shows no screenshot for this window; the Quality Code and comment are from its text.
